name: Identity & Access Management
description: Identity and access management (IAM) — also called identity governance, IGA, joiner-mover-leaver/provisioning, directory and entitlement management, or access lifecycle — centralized governance of identities, entitlements, and authentication policy across the system. The place to look for IAM, identity governance, account provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement management, or the lifecycle control over who has access.
